part.name: ALBERO SUPPORTO CVP30-3N-16/DN (Y) / SUPPORTO SHAFT CVP30-3N-16/DN (Y)

coordinate_system.orientation_notes: Main SECTION A-A coordinate note is treated as controlling: X is the horizontal shaft axis and Y/Z are radial directions. Detail views use local axial/radial orientation, and Section B-B is a transverse cut through the left spline/cross-hole region. Datum A establishes the principal shaft axis.

features.name: Left External Spline
features.description: External involute spline on the left side of the shaft.

features.name: Cross Hole
features.description: Horizontal cross hole passing entirely through the central axis of the shaft section.

gdt_controls.applied_to: axis of the horizontal cross hole

features.name: Left Internal Thread and Center Bore
features.description: M10 threaded hole with center drill profile on the left axis.

features.name: External relief groove
features.description: External groove with a flat bottom and a minimum radius on the left flank.

features.name: Right Flange
features.description: Flange at the right end of the part.

features.name: Alternative execution corner fillet
features.description: Inner corner fillet at a step/shoulder, provided as an alternative execution method.

features.name: Internal bore step
features.description: Internal stepped bore or recess with a defined length and corner radius.

features.name: Internal chamfer
features.description: Chamfer at the right-side opening of the internal bore.

features.name: Chamfered collar
features.description: Raised external cylindrical section adjacent to the groove, featuring chamfers on both the left and right edges.

features.name: Main Shaft Body
features.description: Stepped cylindrical shaft. Left side features an external spline and internal threaded bore. Right side features a flange and internal spline.

features.name: Right End Face (Datum C)
features.description: Flat face at the right end of the flange, designated as Datum C.

features.name: Left End Face
features.description: Flat face at the left end of the shaft.

features.name: Main Central Cylinder
features.description: Central cylindrical section serving as Datum A.

features.name: Right Internal Spline
features.description: Internal involute spline bore on the right side.

relationships.detail: Left internal thread/center bore is drawn on the shaft centerline shared with datum A central cylinder.
Left external spline and datum A central cylinder are coaxial stepped shaft sections.
Right flange outside diameter shares the main shaft axis with datum A central cylinder.
Internal spline bore has concentricity control relative to datum A.
F9_GDT1 references datum A for the internal spline bore.
Right flange end face has perpendicularity control relative to datum A.
F10_GDT1 references datum A for the right face of the flange.
Left face of the flange has parallelism control relative to datum C on the right end face.
F8_GDT1 references datum C for the flange face parallelism control.
Cross-hole angularity control references datum A.
Spline tooth-width symmetry control references datum B, which is defined on the root-diameter surface of the same grouped external spline feature.
Section B-B and the main view identify the cross hole as passing through the left external spline section.
Section B-B shows the transverse cross hole passing through the shaft central axis where the central axial bore is observed.
Detail B shows the external relief groove adjacent to and cut into the chamfered collar region.
Detail A describes the internal chamfer at the opening of the internal bore step.
Left end face and right flange end face are opposing axial end faces of the shaft body.

datums.description: Root diameter of the external spline

datum_scheme.datum_hierarchy_notes: Datum A is the principal cylindrical shaft datum used by the internal spline, cross-hole, and right flange face controls. Datum C is the planar right flange end face used for flange-face parallelism. Datum B is the external spline root diameter used by the spline tooth-width symmetry control.

assumptions.text: Grouped main_shaft_view:F4 with section_b_b:F1 using the SECTION B-B cross-reference through the left external spline; main_shaft_view:F4 was chosen as canonical because it carries the longitudinal spline length, outer diameter, and spline specification.

Grouped main_shaft_view:F5 with section_b_b:F2 as the same transverse cross hole; section_b_b:F2 was chosen as canonical because it carries the hole diameter and GD&T, while the main view contributes axial position context.

Grouped main_shaft_view:F3 with section_b_b:F3 as the same central axial bore/thread region visible in the transverse section; main_shaft_view:F3 was chosen as canonical because it is dimensioned and includes the thread specification.
Grouped main_shaft_view:F6 with detail_b:F1 from the SEE DETAIL B callout; detail_b:F1 was chosen as canonical because the detail view provides the groove diameter and width.

Grouped main_shaft_view:F8 with detail_a:F1 from the SEE DETAIL A callout, interpreting the external shoulder undercut as the primary detailed feature of the flange shoulder zone; main_shaft_view:F8 was chosen as canonical because it carries the flange OD, width, and GD&T.

Kept detail_a:F2 and detail_a:F3 as separate singleton internal bore/chamfer features rather than merging them into main_shaft_view:F9 because no direct feature-level cross-reference uniquely identifies them as the right internal spline feature.
Kept detail_b:F2 as a singleton chamfered collar adjacent to the Detail B groove because no main-view feature uniquely represents the Ø36.2 collar.
Kept alternative_execution:F1 as a singleton optional/alternative fillet detail because it is not directly tied to a specific main-view feature beyond the general alternative-execution note.
Used the main view X-axis as the global shaft axis despite Section B-B using a local note that names Z as the shaft axis; section and detail axes were treated as local view orientations.
